decisions.reason: As a multi-model desk system tightly aligned with the firm's office and conference strengths, it likely has shown enough strategic fit by now to keep, while only a modest risk remains if demand has plateaued.
This chair family sits close to the core portfolio and can be carried at relatively low incremental cost, so it remains worth keeping as part of the firm's broad premium interior offer.
After several years, the sofa's initially weak prominence and the firm's many nearby alternatives mean uncertainty should be largely resolved and the option value of waiting is now low.

Although more distant from the historical core, the rug collection supports the firm's strategic move toward holistic, internationally relevant interiors, so it is still worth keeping despite a meaningful review risk.
